matching: Every request must equal one template exactly, byte for byte, after the slots are filled. No globbing, no trimming, no shell evaluation of the request. Anything else is refused with exit 64 and 'wooloo-peer-bridge: <reason>' on stderr.

transports.stdin: SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND is exactly '/bin/sh -s'; stdin (at most 16384 bytes) must be markerPrefix followed by the template.

markerResponse: Requests framed with markerPrefix (all stdin ones, and argv ones whose template starts with it) get the line 'herdr-remote-output-ready:1' on stdout, preceded by an empty line, before any other output.

slots.herdr: the Herdr path recorded at pairing time, exactly; ^/[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$ (left bare by Herdr's shell_quote)
slots.sessionArgs: empty when the session is 'default', else '--session {session} ' (one trailing space)
slots.version: ^[0-9A-Za-z.+-]{1,32}$, the client's Herdr version, any value in that set

entries.name: herdr-api-discovery
entries.template:
/bin/sh -c 'printf '\''
%s
'\'' '\''herdr-remote-output-ready:1'\''
set -f
candidates=$(
command -v herdr
home=${HOME:-}
user=${USER:-}
version={version}
emit() {
    path=$1
    if [ -n "$path" ] && [ -x "$path" ]; then
        printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$path"
    fi
}
if [ -n "$home" ]; then
    emit "$home/.local/bin/herdr"
fi
    emit "/opt/homebrew/bin/herdr"
    emit "/usr/local/bin/herdr"
if [ -n "$home" ]; then
    emit "$home/.local/share/mise/installs/herdr/$version/bin/herdr"
    emit "$home/.local/share/mise/installs/herdr/$version/herdr"
    emit "$home/.local/share/mise/installs/github-ogulcancelik-herdr/$version/herdr"
    emit "$home/.nix-profile/bin/herdr"
fi
if [ -n "$user" ]; then
    emit "/etc/profiles/per-user/$user/bin/herdr"
fi
emit "/nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin/herdr"
emit "/run/current-system/sw/bin/herdr"

)
IFS='\''
'\''
for candidate in $candidates; do
    case "$candidate" in
        */mise/shims/herdr) continue ;;
        /*) ;;
        *) continue ;;
    esac
    [ -x "$candidate" ] || continue
    if capability=$("$candidate" --session {session} remote-api-bridge --check </dev/null 2>/dev/null) && [ "$capability" = herdr-api-bridge-v1 ]; then
        printf '\''%s\n'\'' "$candidate"
        exit 0
    fi
done
printf '\''%s\n'\'' '\''remote Herdr does not support machine API forwarding; update Herdr on this machine'\'' >&2
exit 2'
entries.response: marker line, then the paired herdr path if 'herdr --session {session} remote-api-bridge --check' prints herdr-api-bridge-v1, else the script's stderr line and exit 2
entries.notes: posix_remote_api_discovery_command (framed_user_shell_output). {session} is bare (shell_quote leaves valid names unquoted); {version} is the client's own Herdr version.

entries.name: herdr-cached-api
entries.template:
/bin/sh -c 'if capability=$({herdr} --session {session} remote-api-bridge --check </dev/null 2>/dev/null) && [ "$capability" = herdr-api-bridge-v1 ]; then
printf '\''
%s
'\'' '\''herdr-remote-output-ready:1'\''
exec {herdr} --session {session} remote-api-bridge
else
    printf '\''%s\n'\'' '\''herdr-machine-metadata-stale-v1'\'' >&2
    exit 78
fi'
entries.response: if the --check succeeds: marker line, then exec herdr --session {session} remote-api-bridge; else 'herdr-machine-metadata-stale-v1' on stderr, exit 78
entries.notes: saved.rs cached_remote_api_command. Writes presence when the bridge runs.

refused: Any other '/bin/sh -s' stdin script, including Herdr's install scripts (attach.rs install_herdr)
Live handoff (live_handoff_command) and server stop/shutdown commands
The Linux candidate script and every Windows PowerShell form
Requests over 16384 bytes, empty requests, or anything with a bad peer name
